text: Both .ops-operations and .ops-timeline use flex-direction: row; switch them to column so children stack.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && sed -i -e '31s/flex-direction: row/flex-direction: column/' -e '36s/flex-direction: row/flex-direction: column/' ops.css && sed -n '31p;36p' ops.css
